{{short description|German mathematician}}
'''Jakob Horn''' (14 February 1867 – 24 February 1946) was a German [[mathematician]] who introduced [[Horn function]]s.<ref>[http://www.deutsche-biographie.de/sfz33822.html Horn, Jakob – Deutsche Biographie]</ref>

==Works==
* {{cite book|title=Über systeme linearer Differentialgleichungen mit mehreren Veränderlichen: Beiträge zur Verallgemeinerungen der Fuchs'schen Theorie der linearer Differentialgleichungen|publisher=Mayer & Müller|year=1890|url=https://archive.org/details/uebersystemelin00horngoog}} (123 pages)
* {{cite book|title=Über die Konvergenz der hypergeometrischen Reihen zweier und dreier Veränderlichen|publisher=B. G. Teubner|location=Leipzig|year=1889}} (59 pages)
* {{cite book|title=Gewöhnliche Differentialgleichungen beliebiger Ordnung|publisher=G. J. Göschen|location=Leipzig|year=1905|url=https://archive.org/details/gewhnlichediffe01horngoog}}
* {{cite book|title=Einführung in die Theorie der partiellen Differentialgleichungen|publisher=G. J. Göschen|location=Leipzig|year=1910|url=https://archive.org/details/einfhrungindie00hornuoft}}<ref>{{cite journal|author=Crathorne, A. R.|title=Review: ''Einführung in die Theorie der partiellen Differentialgleichungen'', by J. Horn|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1913|volume=19|issue=10|pages=254–256|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1913-19-05/S0002-9904-1913-02345-0/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1913-02345-0|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* {{cite book|title=Partielle Gleichungen|publisher=G. J. Göschen|year=1929}}<ref>{{cite journal|author=Margenau, Henry|title=Review: ''Partielle Gleichungen'', by J. Horn|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1932|volume=38|issue=7|page=479|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1932-38-07/S0002-9904-1932-05450-7/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1932-05450-7|doi-access=free}}</ref>
* {{cite book|title=Gewöhnlichen Differentialgleichungen|publisher=G. J. Göschen|year=1948|edition=5th}} (237 pages)
